nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 傍晚的开普敦，桌山顶上的云像一张铺开的白布。你按声音地图留下的坐标，登上了信号山。

nodes.speaker: Amara
nodes.text: You made it before sunset. Good. The signal only appears when the city lights come on.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 守着旧无线电的 Amara 是一名社区电台制作人。她把你的线索压在桌角，旋动布满划痕的调谐钮。

nodes.speaker: Amara
nodes.text: Nobody knows. Every recording is signed E.M., but the voices come from different decades.

nodes.speaker: Amara
nodes.text: A phrase repeated in different accents. Same words, different lives. Listen past the static.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 电流声忽然退去。老式扬声器里，伦敦的雨、墨尔本的海浪和纽约地铁的轰鸣短暂叠在一起。

nodes.speaker: 录音
nodes.text: A city is not its buildings. It is the way strangers learn to hear one another.

nodes.speaker: Amara
nodes.text: There. And underneath it—two names. One belongs to a city you haven't visited yet.

nodes.speaker: Amara
nodes.text: Exactly. A map is only useful when somebody is brave enough to move.

nodes.speaker: Amara
nodes.text: Already did. Stories disappear when nobody carries them forward. You're carrying this one.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 城市的灯沿海湾逐一点亮。Amara 把录音拷进你的手机，又在声音地图上圈出了下一座城市。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 140 金币】信号山的广播，为下一次相遇指明了方向。
